ANHYDROUS DIBORON TRIOXIDE 1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of tests for Diboron Trioxide (13 :0,) used in nuclear reactors, 2 REFERENCES The standards listed below contain provis ions which through reference in this text . constitute provisions of thi s sta nda rd. At the time of publication. the editions indicated were valid . All standards are subject to revi sions and parties to agreements based on this standard arc encouraged to inve stigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions o f the standards indicated below.

SPECIFICATION

3 TERMINOLOGY For the purpose of this standard. the following defin itions shall apply. 3.1 Nuclear Reactor - A de vi ce in which a self sustaining nuclear fi xs ion c ha in reaction can he maintained and controlled (fi ~sion reactor) . 3.2 Reactor Contrnl - The intentional variations of the reaction rate in a nuclear reactor obtained by adjustment 01 reactivity to achieve or maintain a desired state of operation.
